title: chantier-status/1 — the fiche of one chantier sub-session
description: Written by the sub-session only (single writer), at docs/chantiers/{chantier}/{slice}.json on the slice branch. A small typed record, not a report: evidence[] holds references (sha, file:line, URL, screenshot path), never pasted prose. Mirrored by hand in .claude/hooks/lib/chantier-status.mjs (validateFiche) — change both together. 337.a adds OPTIONAL fields for the fleet board (/projects, docs/METHOD/templates/fleet-board.md): session, next, tasks[], screens[], object options, recoId, task, minutes, answeredAt, answeredVia — a fiche without them stays valid; the sub-session adds them on its next write. Cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot state (answeredVia needs answeredAt, options never mixed strings and objects, recoId names an option id, task / waitsOn name tasks of the fiche) are enforced by validateFiche in .claude/hooks/lib/chantier-status.mjs.

agent.description: owner of the slice (picks the avatar): a cohort id (junia … oscar) or a domain owner declared in the app's business pack (docs/project/business/README.md) — a lowercase slug

title.description: the object of the slice, in operator words

branch.description: the slice branch — the Stop hook finds the fiche by it

state.description: waiting = needs Nicolas; blocked = cannot proceed

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601, last fiche write — stamped from the real clock, never guessed; later than now + 120 s is invalid

head.description: commit the fiche describes (on `landed`: the landed sha); null before the first commit

decisions.description: questions that shape the end result; a question for Nicolas lives here, never only in chat. 322.g: a REVERSIBLE decision never stops the slice (state stays `working`; at `deadline` with no answer the supervisor routes the reco and the slice marks it `defaulted`); only a non-reversible one (the conflict gate: data model, permissions/money, irreversible, external production writes) puts the slice in `waiting`

options.description: 337.a: all plain strings, or all {id,label,why} objects (never mixed); object ids are unique

recoId.description: 337.a: the id of the recommended option — only with object options, and it must name one of them

ifNoAnswer.description: reversible: restates the reco applied at the deadline; non-reversible: what stays blocked

reversible.description: true = a wrong call can be undone cheaply, so the slice keeps working and the reco is applied at the deadline; false = the conflict gate, the slice waits. In doubt: false

deadline.description: ISO-8601 with timezone = the time the decision was raised + 2 h, stamped from the real clock. Required (a string) when reversible is true; absent or null when false

status.description: defaulted = the deadline passed with no answer and the reco was applied (reversible decisions only; `answer` holds the reco)

operatorActions.description: things only Nicolas can do that block the slice

review.description: results (or the plan) to evaluate, each with its quiz

evidence.description: links: commit sha, file:line, URL, screenshot path

script.description: the <= 3-minute script Nicolas can play himself: numbered steps, each with its expected result (→ you see …)

urls.description: 330.b: the exact clickable URL(s) to open, real slug/locale/params, never a placeholder — required when kind is result

notProven.description: 330.b: what this ask does not cover (failure/recovery case, persona, environment); "Rien" when nothing

minutes.description: 337.a: how long the script takes to play, in minutes (the board shows 3 when absent)

needsOperator.description: true only for a result clients see or that touches money: it reaches the operator in ONE batch at the slice Recette. false: accepted by Vera's review + Sage's proof (`accepted`, reopenable), never asked

session.description: 337.a: this sub-session's Claude session id (local_…), opened by the board as claude://claude.ai/epitaxy/<session>. The supervisor reads it from list_sessions at adoption and routes `SESSION = local_…`; the sub-session records it. Never guessed: null until routed

next.description: 337.a: the slice's next action, in one line, in operator words

tasks.description: 337.a: the slice's tasks on the six-step ladder, in the order the sub-session works them; ids unique; waitsOn names ids of this array

screens.description: 337.a: the screens this slice touches, with a verdict; the board shows an explicit empty state when no fiche declares any

step.description: the ladder: 0 À faire · 1 En cours · 2 Codé (CODED) · 3 Landé (LANDED) · 4 Déployé (DEPLOYED) · 5 Prouvé (PROVEN)

taskRef.description: 337.a: the tasks[].id this item belongs to — the board puts that row on the operator's desk while the item is open

answeredAt.description: 337.a: when the sub-session recorded the answer (real clock). The board shows « relayé » once this is at or after the board click

answeredVia.description: 337.a: where the answer came from — the /projects desk, the supervisor chat, or the 2 h deadline (defaulted); needs answeredAt

short.description: the row's label when space is short

waitsOn.description: ids of tasks in this fiche that must move first

movedAt.description: when step last changed (real clock) — the board turns the row orange 48 h after it while step < 5

url.description: a clickable URL for the row

blocked.description: why it cannot move, in one line; null or absent = not blocked

verdict.description: keep as is · align on the design system · evolve the screen · talk = needs the operator (on his desk)
